about: Legacy audit of the 516-file MIDI baseline (tools/legacy_audit/audit.js; definitions in tools/legacy_audit/README.md). Integers and strings only. Never regenerate it to make a test pass.

G1.band: progression shapes of the first break and the first drop: distinct >= 50% of seeds, top shape <= 10%, each

G2.band: harmonic rhythm of the first 4 drop bars: "4 x 1-bar slots" (2,2,2,2 half-bars) <= 30% of seeds, >= 4 patterns

G3.band: one-bar repetition in 4-bar windows: drum lanes <= 40% (four-on-the-floor kick windows exempt), bass <= 30%

G4.band: macro changes on phrase-start or phrase-end bars (section bar mod 8 in {0, 7}): >= 50% for bass, chords and lead

G5.band: median per 8-bar window: hats, perc, ghosts >= 10 velocity values with SD 6-22; bass and lead >= 6 values with SD >= 8

G6.band: chord stacks with >= 2 velocities >= 70%; stack onset spread 0-4 ticks

G7.band: feel lanes (hats, perc), median over seeds: residual SD 1.5-6 ticks, lag-1 autocorrelation >= 0.2, DFA alpha 0.65-1.1

G8.band: >= 3 distinct swings (2-tick tolerance) among the non-anchor lanes of the first drop, in every seed
